battle.name: 平涼之戰
battle.brief: 景和七年（430）夏，北魏主力南下河南之際，大夏主赫連定率殘部東進，突襲秦州平涼。守軍以弩砲與礌石壓住雲梯，魏援騎兵循谷道南下，先以弩箭齊射再衝鋒，迫赫連定解圍西撤，退回龍興。翌年赫連定走敦煌被誅，大夏遂亡；卡面的秦弩，正是在平涼城頭撐住防線的那件兵器。

kit.name: 秦弩
kit.history: 弩機把拉力存起來，射速遠勝拉弓。守城的一方靠它把攻城的人壓在牆外。

countries: 北魏一方：太武帝拓跋燾以平城為都，景和七年（430）七月才以太和中軍南下河南，因此西線只能以偏師應急。魏軍體系以拓跋部騎兵為骨幹，配漢人將領與歸附的鮮卑、羌、氐部眾兵，郡兵與屯田民夫擔任糧秣、器械與築城。援軍自平城、關中兩路調集，來回行程都在千里以上，總帥是拓跋燾本人，前線則交由鎮軍將領便宜行事。大夏一方：赫連勃勃建立的匈奴政權以統萬城為都，赫連昌於景和五年（428）兵敗上邽身死，赫連定帶著殘部退守龍興，兵力只剩數千，馬匹與糧秣都靠隴右的屯墾與掠奪維繫，部眾多為匈奴、屠各與被裹挲的秦晉流民，號令由赫連氏王庭直接發出，再沒有第二個樞紐。兩軍同出塞北，騎兵的編制與戰術互相看得懂，卻為了一個已經空掉的中原與河西，差了整整一代人。
countriesEn: One of the two belligerents was Northern Wei. Emperor Taiwu Tuoba Tao ruled from Pingcheng, and only in the seventh month of the seventh year of Jinghe (430) did he take the central host south against the Liu Song, so the western front could be covered only by a detached column. Wei's army was built on Tuoba cavalry, with Han Chinese generals and absorbed Xianbei, Qiang and Di contingents serving alongside; garrison troops of the commanderies and men from the state farms supplied the grain, the engines and the works. The relieving force was drawn from two directions, Pingcheng and Guanzhong, each more than a thousand li from the field, and the supreme commander was the emperor himself in Pingcheng, while on the spot the decisions were left to the generals holding the towns. The other belligerent was the Great Xia state of the Xiongnu, founded by Helian Bobo with its capital at Tongwan. After Helian Chang was defeated and killed at Shanggui in the fifth year of Jinghe (428), Helian Ding fell back with the remnants of his host to Longxing, where only a few thousand men remained and both mounts and grain had to be scraped together from the fields and raids of Longyou; most of his troops were Xiongnu, Diguhun and Qin-Jin refugees pressed into the ranks, and every order came straight from the Helian court, which now had no second hinge to turn on. Both armies came out of the steppe, so each understood the other's cavalry organisation and manoeuvre, yet for the emptied Central Plain and the Hexi Corridor they were a whole generation apart.
people: 拓跋燾（424—452），北魏第三位皇帝，是這一役的決策者。景和七年他同時經營南北：七月詔諸軍伐宋，十月攻下虎牢，戰事牽住他的主力；西線的處置則留在平城遙控，下令徵調關中與涼州的兵馬往援秦州。赫連定是赫連勃勃之子、大夏第三代君主，父兄相繼敗亡之後退守龍興。據《魏書》與《晉書》記載，他不甘坐困，於景和七年夏率部東進，攻城不下而敗退，翌年西走敦煌，被北涼沮渠牧犍派去的騎兵所殺，赫連氏一脈自此斷絕。赫連勃勃是開國者，早年以匈奴鐵弗部立國，營建統萬城，他留下的關中、隴右、河西縱深，也成了子孫困局的根源。沮渠牧犍是北涼的涼王，敦煌一事的善後由他經手。吐谷渾首領慕容羶同期控制青海一帶，趁勢西進，與魏在隴右形成三面牽制的格局。至於魏軍主將的姓名，《資治通鑑》此段只以「遣兵」「師至」概之，並未記載；這是本役史料最鮮明的空白之一。
peopleEn: Tuoba Tao (424-452), the third emperor of Northern Wei, was the man who decided this campaign. In the seventh year of Jinghe he was running two fronts at once: in the seventh month he summoned the armies against the Song and in the tenth month he took Hulao, and that war tied down the bulk of his strength; the western front was handled by remote command from Pingcheng, with orders sent out to draw troops and horses from Guanzhong and Liangzhou to reinforce Qinzhou. Helian Ding was the son of Helian Bobo and the third ruler of Great Xia, and after his father and elder brother were defeated in turn he had fallen back on Longxing. The Wei Shu and the Jin Shu record that he would not sit still, that in the summer of the seventh year of Jinghe he led his host east, failed to take the city and was beaten back, and that the following year he fled west to Dunhuang and was killed by horsemen sent out by Juqu Mujian, ruler of Northern Liang, which ended the Helian line for good. Helian Bobo, the founder, had raised the state among the Xianbei-branch Xiongnu of the Tiefu tribe and built the new capital of Tongwan; the depth he opened up along Guanzhong, Longyou and the Hexi Corridor became the source of his descendants' predicament. Juqu Mujian, the Liang king, handled the aftermath at Dunhuang. The Tuyuhun ruler Murong Shan held the region around Qinghai at this time and pushed west, pinning the three sides of Longyou against each other. As for the name of the Wei commander, the Zizhi Tongjian gives only such phrases as sent troops and the army arrived, and records no name; this is the sharpest blank in the sources for the engagement.
kits: 卡面這件秦弩，才是戰場上真正定勝負的器械。弩機把弦的拉力先行儲存，射手不必像拉弓那樣在放箭的一瞬間耗盡臂力，因此可以在城頭長時間維持射速；張弦、上機、扣扳三個動作分解之後，弩手能夠單手完成拈矢、窺瞄與擊發。十六國時期軍隊常備的蹶張弩，張力以石計，常見三石到七石，要靠腰足之力上弦，步行兵一人一具、可以連發數箭；守城用的巨弩張力可達數十石，須用絞盤加十數人合力上弦，一發可破門扉或重創人馬，射程約二百步上下，優於弓的一百步左右。攻城一方照例備雲梯、撞車與穴地，盾兵先登、步卒壓上，弩手在後列仰射，壓制城頭射手；輕弩則隨騎兵出戰，用於追擊與掩護潰退。雙方真正吃緊的是箭：弩箭短而密，一囊裝數十支，打上幾日便要就地補充，涼州與雍州的匠戶因此被大量徵發，造弩機部件與箭桿。補給線越長，弩的優勢越容易被糧秣拖垮。
kitsEn: The Chinese crossbow on the card is the piece of equipment that actually decided the field. The lock stores the strain of the string first, so the shooter does not have to spend his whole strength at the instant of release as a bowman must, and that is what allows a rate of fire to be kept up for hours on a wall; once cocking, loading and triggering are separated into three motions, the archer can nock an arrow, take aim and loose with one hand. The drawn crossbow that field troops carried in the Sixteen Kingdoms was rated in dan of tension, commonly three to seven dan, cocked by waist and leg, one per infantryman and capable of several shots in succession; the great engines used on walls could take tens of dan and had to be cocked by a windlass worked by a dozen men at once, and a single bolt could break a gate leaf or kill horses and men, at an effective range of about two hundred paces against a bow's hundred. The besiegers kept to the usual preparation: scaling ladders, battering rams and mining, with shield-bearers first up, foot following, and crossbowmen in the rear shooting upward to clear the defenders on the wall; light crossbows went out with the cavalry, used in pursuit and to cover a withdrawal. What truly ran short on both sides was ammunition: crossbow bolts are short and packed densely, a quiver holding some dozens, and a few days of fighting forced local resupply, so the artisans of Liangzhou and Yongzhou were levied in large numbers to make lock parts and bolt shafts. The longer the supply line, the more readily the advantage of the crossbow was throttled by grain.
cause: 打起來的原因有三層。第一層是赫連氏自身的困局：景和四年（427）拓跋燾以偽退之計攻下統萬，景和五年赫連昌兵敗安定、歿於上邽，赫連定帶著殘部退到龍興，兵不過數千，糧秣靠隴右的屯墾與掠奪，馬匹折損大半，政權已無自存之力。第二層是北魏的統一方略：太武帝即位之後先平大夏、再定柔然，關中與涼州之間只要還立著一個割據政權，魏的西路就永遠不安；拔掉平涼，等於拔掉插在關中與河西之間的釘子。第三層是戰機：景和七年七月拓跋燾以太和中軍南下河南，虎牢、洛陽、滑台一線同時吃緊，秦州與涼州的守備降到全季最低，赫連定正是在這個窗口把手中僅存的兵力全部壓上，試圖用一次成功的突襲換回一個可以喘息的據點。而北魏不能容忍的，是一個已經站不穩的政權在自家側後重新站起來。
causeEn: Three layers lie behind the fighting. The first is the Helians' own distress: in the fourth year of Jinghe (427) Tuoba Tao took Tongwan by feigning a retreat, and in the fifth year Helian Chang was beaten at Anding and died at Shanggui; Helian Ding withdrew to Longxing with the remnants, no more than a few thousand men, grain coming from the fields and the raids of Longyou, half the horses broken down, and a state with no means of sustaining itself. The second is Wei's strategy of unification: after Taiwu came to the throne he settled Great Xia first and then turned on the Rouran, and for as long as one separatist state still stood between Guanzhong and Liangzhou the western road of Wei could never be at peace; taking Pingliang meant pulling out the nail driven between Guanzhong and the Hexi Corridor. The third is the opportunity. In the seventh month of the seventh year of Jinghe Tuoba Tao led the central host south against the Song, so that Hulao, Luoyang and Huatai were all under strain at once and the garrisons of Qinzhou and Liangzhou fell to their lowest level of the year; it was in that window that Helian Ding committed every man he still had, hoping that one successful surprise would buy back a place where he could breathe. What Wei could not tolerate was a state that had already lost its footing standing up again behind their own flank.
tactics: 赫連定的打法是先手奪點：他看中拓跋燾主力南下河南、秦州兵力空虛的時機，率輕騎快速東進，直抵平涼城下，圍城步卒與遊騎分作兩路，一部撲城、一部掠糧，試圖在魏軍回援之前拿下這座秦州前線的城。攻城靠雲梯與撞車，步卒舉盾前進，弩手在後列仰射壓制城頭；守軍把弩列在城頭與塹後，用交叉火力把剛剛貼上牆垣的雲梯逼退，再用礌石與拒馬封住缺口。魏國的援騎一到，遠射的弩箭又與騎兵的衝鋒疊在一起，弩箭先行齊射，騎鋒隨後撞進攻城的隊伍。魏軍的應援以騎兵為主，循涇水與隴山之間的谷道南下，不去啃城牆，而是取側背。赫連定部糧秣不繼，又不願把殘兵押在城下，見魏騎兵逼近便解圍西撤，退回龍興。魏軍追出不遠便止：關中到隴右的糧道太長，一次長距離追擊養不起，只能守住平涼、修整城防，準備下一步收拾河西。
tacticsEn: Helian Ding's plan was to seize the point first: he waited for the moment when Tuoba Tao's main host was deep in the south against the Song and Qinzhou was thinly held, drove east with light cavalry, struck the walls of Pingliang, and split his force into two parts, one to hug the city and one to forage, hoping to take the place before Wei could answer. The assault used scaling ladders and battering rams, foot soldiers advancing behind shields while crossbowmen in the rear shot upward to clear the wall. The garrison stood the crossbows along the parapet and behind the outer ditch, crossing the fire to push back the ladders the moment they touched the masonry, and then sealed the gaps with stones and cheval-de-frise. When Wei's relieving horse arrived, the long-range bolts of the crossbows were laid over the charge of the cavalry, a volley first and the mounted shock afterwards, so that the storm of horse met the crowded assault inside the walls. The relief was mounted and came down the valley road between the Jing river and the Long mountains, refusing to grind against the city wall and instead taking the flank. Helian Ding's men were out of grain and unwilling to pin their last soldiers below a city they could not take, so when the Wei horse closed in they broke off the siege and withdrew west to Longxing. Wei did not pursue far: the grain road from Guanzhong to Longyou was too long to support a long chase, so the army held Pingliang, put the walls in order, and prepared for the next step against the Hexi Corridor.
data: 年份是景和七年，即公元430年，戰事起於夏、秋之交，舊史只記大約而不載具體日數。距離是這一役最可靠的尺度：平涼（今甘肅平涼市涇川縣一帶）距魏都平城約八百公里，長安至平涼約三百公里，平涼至大夏都城統萬約六百公里，至龍興約三百公里；一支兩千人的騎隊自平城西行，單程便要二十日上下，糧秣車隊更要走上一個多月。兵力方面，《魏書》《晉書》都沒有留下可以核對的數目；依同期北魏外線作戰的通例，遠征的騎兵以數千之眾為常態，攻城一方還要臨時徵發步卒、匠戶與輜重車，實際投入的總數應遠高於戰鬥兵。弩的技術參數同樣有跡可循：蹶張弩張力三石至七石，巨弩可達數十石，弩的有效射程約二百步，弓約一百步；一名弩手理論上可連發數十箭，但實戰要顧瞄與換矢，一日有效射擊通常在數十發上下。時間上，大夏於景和五年（428）失去安定與上邽，景和七年（430）在平涼再敗，景和八年（431）赫連定死於敦煌，政權僅存三年；北魏同年滅北涼，直到景和十三年（439）才完成北方統一。
dataEn: The year is the seventh year of Jinghe, that is 430 AD, and the fighting began in the turn of summer and autumn; the old histories give only the general season and no exact day. Distance is the most reliable measure this engagement leaves us. Pingliang, in the neighbourhood of today's Pingliang city and Jingchuan county in Gansu, stands about eight hundred kilometres from the Wei capital of Pingcheng, about three hundred from Chang'an, about six hundred from the Xia capital of Tongwan and about three hundred from Longxing. A mounted column of two thousand men marching west from Pingcheng would need roughly twenty days one way, and a grain convoy longer than a month. On numbers of men, neither the Wei Shu nor the Jin Shu leaves anything that can be checked; by the ordinary practice of Wei's operations on remote lines in this period, an expeditionary mounted force numbered in the thousands, and a besieging side had additionally to levy foot soldiers, artisans and baggage trains, so the total committed was much larger than the number actually fighting. The technical figures of the crossbow can still be traced: the drawn crossbow at three to seven dan of tension, the great engines at tens of dan, an effective crossbow range of about two hundred paces against a bow's hundred, a theoretical rate of dozens of shots per archer, reduced in practice by aiming and re-nocking to a few dozen effective shots a day. In time: Great Xia lost Anding and Shanggui in the fifth year of Jinghe (428), was beaten again at Pingliang in 430, and Helian Ding died at Dunhuang in 431, so the state lasted only three years more; Wei destroyed Northern Liang in the same year and completed the unification of the north only in 439.
impact: 平涼一役的直接後果，是大夏在隴右最後的野戰力量被打散，赫連氏只剩龍興一處孤城可以退守；翌年赫連定死於敦煌，這樣的十六國政權之一就此終結，北方只剩北涼與北燕兩個割據局面。北魏由此取得關中通向河西的完整通道，秦州與涼州之間再無可以攔截的割據武力，兩年之後北涼沮渠氏降魏，439年北方統一。另一層影響落在工藝上：涼州、雍州一帶自前秦以來就是弩機、弓弦與箭桿的產地，涼州陷魏之後，這批匠戶被編入軍籍，弩的零件可以沿著軍隊與屯田的體系成批生產並隨軍調度；秦弩由守城器械變成可以隨騎兵作戰的隨身火力，也為此後魏軍在河南、江淮一線組織大型器械攻城準備了技術底子，而消耗量最大的箭矢，更從此成為北方軍鎮年年都要籌措的物資。至於地方，平涼作為秦州西部的關口，經此役之後由魏軍長期駐防，隴右的聚落與屯田也隨之重新編制，關中通往西域的商道再沒有大夏阻隔。
impactEn: The immediate consequence of Pingliang was that the last field army of Great Xia in Longyou was broken up, leaving the Helians with the single isolated city of Longxing to fall back on; the next year Helian Ding died at Dunhuang and one of the Sixteen Kingdoms states came to an end, leaving only Northern Liang and Northern Yan on the northern horizon. Wei thus gained an unbroken road from Guanzhong to the Hexi Corridor, and no separatist force remained between Qinzhou and Liangzhou to intercept it; two years later Juqu Mujian of Northern Liang submitted to Wei, and in 439 the north was united. A second layer of the effect fell on craft and industry. Liangzhou and Yongzhou had been the producing ground for crossbow locks, bowstrings and bolt shafts since Former Qin, and once Liangzhou passed to Wei those artisans were enrolled in the army registers, so that crossbow parts could be made in batches along the lines of the army and the state farms and moved with the troops. The Chinese crossbow ceased to be a wall weapon only and became a portable firepower carried by cavalry, which also gave Wei the technical groundwork for organising large siege engines on the Henan and Jianghuai lines in later years, while the arrows, by far the greatest item of consumption, became a supply that the northern garrisons had to raise every single year. Locally, Pingliang, as the western pass of Qinzhou, was thereafter garrisoned by Wei for a long time, the settlements and state farms of Longyou were reorganised along with it, and the trade road from Guanzhong into the western regions was no longer blocked by a Xia state.
result: 結果是攻守兩易：赫連定攻不下平涼，部眾在城下與歸路上被魏騎兵咬住，被迫解圍西撤，退回龍興；魏軍守住了秦州前線這座城，卻沒有乘勢追進隴西深處，原因是關中到隴右的糧道撐不住一次長距離追擊。大夏此後再無反攻能力，赫連定於景和八年（431）西走敦煌，被北涼沮渠牧犍派出的騎兵所殺，妻、子與部眾北奔魏國，赫連勃勃建立的政權正式滅亡。平涼城經此一役成為魏在秦州的西面支點，魏軍可以由此西向涼州、南望關中，兩面作戰。北魏在景和七年同一年先取虎牢、洛陽，滅掉北涼之後完成北方統一，戰史上把平涼之戰算作這一連串行動中的一環：它不像虎牢那樣被記在戰史的正文，卻把大夏最後的餘部從地圖上抹去。關於此役的兵力、陣亡與繳獲，古籍沒有留下可信的數目；可以確定的只有攻方失敗、圍解、殘部西撤與三年後大夏覆亡這四件事。
resultEn: The outcome cut both ways. Helian Ding could not take Pingliang, and his troops were bitten at the walls and on the road back by Wei's cavalry, so he was forced to lift the siege and withdraw west to Longxing. Wei kept the city on the Qinzhou front line but did not press the advantage deep into Longyou, because the grain road from Guanzhong to Longyou could not carry a long pursuit. Great Xia never mounted another offensive: in the eighth year of Jinghe (431) Helian Ding went west to Dunhuang and was killed by horsemen dispatched by Juqu Mujian of Northern Liang, while his wife, children and followers fled north to Wei, and the state founded by Helian Bobo was formally extinguished. After this engagement Pingliang became Wei's western pivot in Qinzhou, from which the army could face Liangzhou to the west and Guanzhong to the south and fight on two fronts. In the same year of Jinghe, Wei took Hulao and Luoyang, and after the fall of Northern Liang it completed the unification of the north; in the historical sequence, Pingliang counts as one link in that chain. It is not narrated in the main text of the war annals the way Hulao is, yet it is what removed the last remnants of Great Xia from the map. As for the strength of the armies, the casualties and the booty, the old books leave no figures that can be trusted; what can be settled is only these four things: the attacker failed, the siege was lifted, the remnants withdrew west, and three years later Great Xia was gone.
